about: Entries for CPUIDs the article has no row for, each fact with the page it came from. import.py appends them after the article's and refuses one whose CPUID the article has: the article's own row is kept. A model's codes are ARK's, in ark-sspec.json, placed by enrich.py. A stepping no source ties to the CPUID is left empty, not guessed.

entries.note: From Intel's microcode release notes, which name the code name (abbreviated: ARL-S/HX (8P)), the steppings and the product line for this CPUID; the article has no row for it. Its models are the desktop and HX parts whose ARK ordering tab gives B0: ARK writes one code name, Arrow Lake, for every die, so the notes' label (ARL-S/HX) decides with the stepping.
